name: m4-symfinal-scala
description: The candidate cut from [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199), final `Symbol` predicates, `info`, `rawInfo`, `owner`, `typeOfThis`, `tpe_*`, `mapOverType` and the `decls` fast path, against `2.13.x`: a full compile of the scala corpus. The whole of #199 against the integration branch was −4.09% ±0.64 in `m4-devirt-tip-ab`, but this has a different base and fewer commits, so the two aren't directly comparable.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, no profiler.
